about: Input for tools/comfy/palette_extract.py: where each material is sampled on the approved front concept. Boxes are [x0, y0, x1, y1] in concept pixels (1536x1024, origin top-left, x1/y1 exclusive); hue in degrees, sat/val in 0-1 (HSV), applied inside the boxes after the flat background is removed. tones = lightness (CIELAB L*) percentiles reported as shadow/base/highlight. Edit a box, re-run the tool, look at reports/stage0_palette_samples.png.

swatches.label: Skin
swatches.note: warm sun-dark skin; soot flecks and lava cracks are painted on top

swatches.label: Hair & beard
swatches.note: near-black warm brown; the short beard frames the jaw

swatches.label: Eye glow
swatches.note: tiny at game scale; the brow shadow + glow pair is what reads

swatches.label: Gauntlet rock
swatches.note: near-black basalt; reads by value on lit floors, sinks on dark ones

swatches.label: Lava glow
swatches.note: cracks + chest sigil; unlit in the shader, bloom does the rest

swatches.label: Bronze bands & buckle

swatches.label: Scale-plate skirt

swatches.label: Belt leather

swatches.label: Torn cloth
